summary: Completed RBAC & SSOT WhatsApp Payload security hardening testing. Fixed critical P0 bug in bookings.py (complete endpoint). Verified all RBAC holes are closed, ownership checks work correctly, SSOT payload is complete, and notifications visibility is properly scoped.

critical_bugs.issue: Used get_current_user instead of MANAGER dependency, allowing drivers to complete bookings
critical_bugs.impact: RBAC bypass - drivers could complete bookings when only owner/ops_admin should be allowed
critical_bugs.fix_applied: Changed user=Depends(get_current_user) to user=Depends(MANAGER) in bookings.py line 240

passed_tests: P0: Driver POST /api/bookings/{id}/complete returns 403 (RBAC enforced - FIXED)
P0: Driver can checkin their own trip (ownership verified)
P0: Driver CANNOT checkin another driver's trip (403 - ownership enforced)
P0: Driver CANNOT checkout another driver's trip (403 - ownership enforced)
P1: SSOT WhatsApp Payload - trip.started event has complete payload (company, destination, driver_phone, pickup, vehicle_name, customer_name)
P1: SSOT WhatsApp Payload - trip.arrived event has complete payload
P1: SSOT WhatsApp Payload - trip.completed event has complete payload
P1: Driver can POST location for their own trip (ownership verified)
P1: Driver CANNOT POST location for another driver's trip (403 - ownership enforced)
P1: Owner can POST location for any trip (unrestricted access)
P2: Owner can trigger notification scan (authorized)
P2: Owner can read manager notification (200 - visibility verified)
P2: Driver CANNOT read manager notification (404 - visibility enforced)
P2: Owner can dismiss manager notification (200 - visibility verified)
P2: Driver CANNOT dismiss manager notification (404 - visibility enforced)
Regression: Full booking flow works (create -> confirm -> status)

p0_rbac_bookings.description: All booking mutation endpoints (POST, PATCH, confirm, cancel, complete) correctly enforce RBAC - only owner/ops_admin can mutate. Driver has read-only access (GET endpoints return 200).
p0_rbac_bookings.bug_fixed: POST /api/bookings/{id}/complete now correctly uses MANAGER dependency instead of get_current_user

p0_ownership_driver.description: Driver ownership checks work correctly for checkin/checkout. Driver can only checkin/checkout their own trips (403 for other drivers' trips).

p1_ssot_wa_payload.description: SSOT WhatsApp payload implementation verified. All trip events (trip.started, trip.arrived, trip.completed) contain complete WA variables: company='Rahaza Travel', destination='Bandung', driver_phone='0811000003', pickup='Jakarta Pusat', vehicle_name='Hiace Premio 01', customer_name='CV Sentosa Wisata'. Consistent with dispatch events.

p1_ownership_locations.description: Driver ownership checks work correctly for POST /api/locations. Driver can only post locations for their own trips (403 for other drivers' trips). Owner/ops_admin unrestricted.

p2_notifications_visibility.description: Notifications visibility correctly scoped. Driver cannot read/dismiss manager-targeted notifications (404). Owner can read/dismiss manager notifications (200).

regression.description: All regression tests passed. Full booking flow works, anti double-booking (INV-4) correctly rejects overlaps, all critical endpoints return 200 without 5xx errors.
